name: Diamond (50+ GP)
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Chromatic Orb requires: a diamond worth 50+ GP.

authored_operations: Validate the exact source form and minimum worth, not merely the shop price; track actual quantity and copy identity. Consumed components are paid once for the original casting, including ritual casts.

A reusable component remains owned after casting. Warding Bond requires two separate qualifying rings worn by caster/target for the duration; never interpret 50 GP as the whole pair. A Clairvoyance horn/eye matches the initial sense choice.

definition.name: Diamond (50 GP)
definition.description: A diamond worth 50 GP, the reusable Material component of Chromatic Orb.

consumers.details: Positive shop type/value and, for consumables, declared supported effect names. This is a source selection lead, not a loaded availability certification; manifest wins remain authoritative.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map exact form, minimum worth and consumption per original cast, including rituals and paid/cancelled/Ready continuations. Do not equate shop price with component worth; consumed or priced components cannot be replaced with a generic focus/pouch.
